Technology choices (Bash/PowerShell/jq/JSON) are in Technical Summary, Assumptions and frontend-spec.md Technology Stack.

The Architecture flowchart and Components table form a DAG (fixtures -> tests -> baseline/schema/extension points). Collection (_loop_trace_emit) and comparison (assert_event_trace) are separate, one-directional functions. No cycle found.

Data Plan states Data Entities (none persisted by this task; future additive fields and schemas documented), Existing Data Affected (none; the 8 loop-inventory entries are unmodified), and Migration Strategy (no migration required, with rationale). API / Contract Plan lists assert_capability_applicability, _loop_trace_emit, assert_event_trace, the emit-run-record.sh flags with a four-combination outcome table, capture/promote-golden-baseline.sh CLI contracts, and the build_fixture 5-parameter signature. It states that the no-flag output is byte-identical (AC-011) and that capability-only is a usage error.

Security Boundaries table names B1-B3 with auth/authz mechanism, data classification, and OWASP concerns. security-spec.md expands this to B1-B5 with STRIDE, OWASP mapping and data classification, and no PII is handled. No contradiction with design.md found.
